title: Why Are Ticketmaster Fees So High?
description:
The FTC says Ticketmaster fees reached as high as 44% of a ticket and totaled $16.4 billion from 2019 to 2024, and a New York jury found Live Nation and Ticketmaster ran a monopoly.
#ticketmaster #concerts #money #shorts

Sources: FTC press release (Sep 18, 2025); TicketNews (Sep 2025); CNN via KVIA (Apr 15, 2026); Quartz (Apr 2026); FTC fees rule via TechCrunch (May 5, 2025) and Barnes & Thornburg (2025); CelebrityAccess (May 12, 2026); CPI/PYMNTS (May 22, 2026)
Photos: rick, Jeffrey, bary0n, James Cridland, marfis75 (CC BY 2.0, Flickr)
tags: why are ticketmaster fees so high
first_comment: Be honest: would you still pay Ticketmaster fees for your favorite artist, or skip the show? 🎤

scenes.say: Ticketmaster fees can add {44%|forty four percent} to your ticket.
scenes.source: FTC press release Sep 18 2025 (Ticketmaster 'hid the mandatory fees, which are as high as 44% of the cost of the ticket'); TicketNews Sep 2025 (mandatory fees can add up to 44% to the ticket cost)

scenes.say: There's a service fee, a facility fee, an order processing fee.
scenes.source: TicketNews Sep 2025 (fee types: service charges, order processing fees, facility fees); FTC fees rule coverage via TechCrunch May 2025 (labels like 'service fees' or 'processing fees')

scenes.say: For years, the FTC says, they showed up at the very end.
scenes.source: FTC press release Sep 2025 (fees not added 'until the very end of the transaction'); TicketNews Sep 2025 (fees not fully revealed until the final steps of an online sale)

scenes.say: Even the FTC's chairman said it shouldn't cost an arm and a leg.

visual.quote: It should not cost an arm and a leg to take the family to a baseball game or attend your favorite musician's show.

scenes.source: FTC press release Sep 18 2025, 'FTC Sues Live Nation and Ticketmaster for Engaging in Illegal Ticket Resale Tactics...', quote from Chairman Andrew N. Ferguson (verbatim); suit also reported by TicketNews and Gizmodo Sep 2025

scenes.say: Those fees totaled {$16.4 BILLION|sixteen point four billion dollars} in six years.
scenes.source: FTC press release Sep 2025 ('The fees totaled $16.4 billion from 2019-2024.'); TicketNews Sep 2025 ($16.4 billion in fees from 2019 to 2024)

scenes.say: Then in April, a New York jury found Live Nation and Ticketmaster ran a monopoly.
scenes.source: CNN via KVIA Apr 15 2026 ('A New York federal jury found that Live Nation and Ticketmaster operated as a monopoly'); Quartz Apr 2026; CPI/PYMNTS May 2026 (jury found Live Nation unlawfully maintained monopoly power)

scenes.say: And that fans were overcharged {$1.72|a dollar seventy two} on every ticket.
scenes.source: Quartz Apr 2026 (jury found fans were overcharged '$1.72 per ticket'); CNN via KVIA Apr 15 2026 (overcharged $1.72 per ticket)

scenes.say: But here's the interesting part. Since May {2025|twenty twenty five}, sites must show the total price up front.
scenes.source: FTC Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees, effective May 12 2025: 'Sites must disclose the total price upfront in ads and other offers for live-event tickets' (TechCrunch May 5 2025); Barnes & Thornburg alert 2025 (rule takes effect May 12, 2025)

scenes.say: The fees didn't go away. They're just inside the first number you see.
scenes.source: TechCrunch May 2025 ('The total price must include all known charges and fees'); fees still charged: FTC suit Sep 2025 and the pending DOJ settlement terms (CNN via KVIA Apr 2026, fee cap proposal)

scenes.say: Now {33|thirty three} states want Ticketmaster split off. Until then, check the total, because
scenes.source: CelebrityAccess May 12 2026 (coalition of 33 states and D.C. seeking 'a full separation of Live Nation and Ticketmaster'); CPI/PYMNTS May 22 2026 (states seek Ticketmaster's divestiture). Loop line into the hook
